fields.Name: AIUsageHourly
fields.UserQuestion: What is our hourly AI usage and cost broken down by model, agent, user, and scope?
fields.Description: Primary hourly aggregation of AI usage facts. Computes model-call counts, token volumes, latencies (P50/P95), cache reads, and spend (by currency) across all dimensional attributes.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Live analytical query over [__mj].vwAIUsageFacts, one row per UTC hour x dimension set x CostCurrency. Optional start/end ({{ start | sqlDate }}, {{ end | sqlDate }}) select whole hours: every hour that overlaps [start, end) is returned complete, by rounding start down and end up to the hour and range-filtering the base RunAt column (sargable on IX_AIPromptRun_RunAt). The hour is derived from RunAt by truncation and exposed as HourBucket (DATETIME) plus BucketStartUTC / BucketEndUTC. Parallel parents are counted in ParallelParents and excluded from every other measure. Latency percentiles are PERCENTILE_CONT window functions collapsed with MAX (SQL Server 2019+).

fields.Name: start
fields.Description: Start UTC date/time boundary for filtering AI usage runs. Guarded by truthiness check — value of 0, empty string, or false will cause this clause to be skipped.

fields.Name: end
fields.Description: End UTC date/time boundary for filtering AI usage runs. Guarded by truthiness check — value of 0, empty string, or false will cause this clause to be skipped.

fields.Name: HourBucket
fields.Description: The start of the hourly bucket as a DATETIME

fields.Name: BucketStartUTC
fields.Description: The start of the hourly bucket in UTC
fields.ComputationDescription: Truncated RunAt timestamp to the nearest hour boundary

fields.Name: BucketEndUTC
fields.Description: The end of the hourly bucket in UTC

fields.Name: AgentID
fields.Description: Identifier of the Agent used

fields.Name: PromptID
fields.Description: Identifier of the prompt template used

fields.Name: ModelID
fields.Description: Identifier of the AI model used

fields.Name: VendorID
fields.Description: Identifier of the AI vendor

fields.Name: UserID
fields.Description: Identifier of the user who triggered the run

fields.Name: PrimaryScopeEntityID
fields.Description: Identifier of the scope entity

fields.Name: PrimaryScopeRecordID
fields.Description: Identifier of the scope record

fields.Name: ConfigurationID
fields.Description: Identifier of the configuration used

fields.Name: SourceKind
fields.Description: The source kind of the prompt execution

fields.Name: CostCurrency
fields.Description: Currency used for cost calculation

fields.Name: Runs
fields.Description: Total number of non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: SucceededRuns
fields.Description: Total number of successful non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 AND x.Success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: FailedRuns
fields.Description: Total number of failed non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 AND x.Success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: PricedRuns
fields.Description: Total number of priced non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 AND x.IsPriced = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: UnpricedRuns
fields.Description: Total number of unpriced non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 AND x.IsPriced = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: UnmeasuredRuns
fields.Description: Total number of unmeasured non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 AND x.IsUnmeasured = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: ParallelParents
fields.Description: Total number of parallel parent executions
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: TokensPrompt
fields.Description: Sum of prompt tokens for non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 THEN x.TokensPrompt ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: TokensCompletion
fields.Description: Sum of completion tokens for non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 THEN x.TokensCompletion ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: TokensCacheRead
fields.Description: Sum of cache read tokens for non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 THEN x.TokensCacheRead ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: TokensCacheWrite
fields.Description: Sum of cache write tokens for non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 THEN x.TokensCacheWrite ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: OwnCost
fields.Description: Total cost of priced non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 AND x.IsPriced = 1 THEN x.OwnCost ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: LatencyP50
fields.Description: Maximum of the 50th percentile of latency (execution time in milliseconds)
fields.ComputationDescription: MAX(x.LatencyP50) where LatencyP50 is calculated using PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) in the subquery

fields.Name: LatencyP95
fields.Description: Maximum of the 95th percentile of latency (execution time in milliseconds)
fields.ComputationDescription: MAX(x.LatencyP95) where LatencyP95 is calculated using PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) in the subquery

fields.Name: AvgFirstTokenMS
fields.Description: Average time to first token in milliseconds for non-parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: AVG(CASE WHEN x.IsParallelParent = 0 THEN x.FirstTokenTime END)
